# reladraw

> reladraw is a text language for diagrams where you say where things go. A file states the arrangement in relative terms (`right of api`, `below worker (gap: tight)`, `even with db`) and the tool draws exactly that, producing a standalone SVG. There are no coordinates and no auto-layout: nothing is moved to make room and no line finds its own way.

Most models have not seen reladraw in training, and its syntax is not Mermaid's, Graphviz's or D2's. Read the full documentation below before writing a file rather than guessing at syntax. Things to know first:

- A statement starts at the beginning of a line and may continue onto indented lines below it. The statements are `node`, `edge`, `point`, `region`, `bundle`, `guide`, `style`, `default`, `diagram` and `icon`. `//` starts a comment; `#` opens a hex color.
- Anything the file leaves ambiguous is refused with an error naming the statement, never guessed. Read the error, fix the file, render again.
- What may not read as meant, such as two boxes on one spot or a line through a box, is drawn as written and reported as a one-line warning saying where and how much. Fix the source until there are none.
- Render with `reladraw render diagram.reladraw -o diagram.svg`, or `npx reladraw render …` without installing. `reladraw check diagram.reladraw` prints only the warnings, and `reladraw format diagram.reladraw` lays the file out again, changing only spacing; run it on a file before handing it over. To show someone the picture, `reladraw render diagram.reladraw --page` writes a self-contained HTML page with pan, zoom and full screen; open that rather than building a page around the SVG.
- These pages describe the main branch, which can run ahead of the release on npm. If the installed tool refuses a construct documented here, check the changelog at the end of the syntax reference.

A small file:

```
node app "Web app"
node app.ui  "Interface"
node app.api "API"  below app.ui (gap: tight)

node store "Database"  right of app (gap: 12)  even with app.api

edge app.api -> store  "queries"
```

## Docs

- [Full documentation](https://reladraw.github.io/reladraw/llms-full.txt): the guide to writing reladraw followed by the complete syntax reference, in one file. Read this one.
- [Syntax reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reladraw/reladraw/main/SYNTAX.md): the complete syntax reference on its own, with the changelog.
- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reladraw/reladraw/main/.claude/skills/reladraw/SKILL.md): the guide to writing reladraw on its own. Installable into agents that support skills with `reladraw install-skill`, which installs the skill matching the installed tool, or `npx skills add reladraw/reladraw` for the main branch's.

## Tools

- [Playground](https://reladraw.github.io/reladraw/): write reladraw in the browser and see the picture as you type.
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/reladraw): the `reladraw` command-line tool and library.

## Optional

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reladraw/reladraw/main/README.md): why the language exists and how it compares with Mermaid and draw.io.
- [Examples](https://github.com/reladraw/reladraw/tree/main/examples): one `.reladraw` file per construct.
